annotations.title: Get state rules on deposits, licenses, handymen and permits

description: Answers rules questions homeowners ask before hiring, for one state: how much a contractor may ask up front (deposit_limit), when a state license is needed (license_threshold), what an unlicensed handyman may do, including electrical or plumbing (handyman_exemption), whether a job needs a permit (permit_needed: give job, e.g. "water heater", and city), whether a homeowner can pull their own permit (who_can_pull_permits), required bonds and insurance, what a contract must include and the right to cancel (contract_requirements), and the official license lookup (license_lookup). Each answer is short, with its key numbers, conditions, exceptions, an official source URL for every fact, the date it was checked and a Swapwire guide link. status not_verified means Swapwire could not confirm it from an official source: send the user to the agency linked, do not guess. Permits are mostly city rules: the answer gives the state baseline and, for cities where Swapwire has permit records, the city's permit portal. States: CA, AZ, CO, CT, FL, GA, HI, IL, KS, LA, MA, MI, MN, NC, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX, VA, WA. Leave topic out for a one-line answer on every topic. General information, not legal advice.

city.description: For permit_needed: the city or county, e.g. "Seattle". Returns its permit portal and any job rules from the city's own pages.

job.description: For permit_needed: the job, in plain words or one of water_heater, hvac_replacement, roof, electrical_panel, fence, deck, bathroom_remodel.

state.description: Two-letter state code or state name, e.g. "CA" or "Texas". Optional when city names a city Swapwire has permit rules for.

topic.description: Which rule. Leave out for a summary of every topic.

name: get_rules

outputSchema.description: One rules topic for one state, or a line per topic when no topic is given. Every fact has an official source and a checked date.

checked.description: Date the sources were checked, YYYY-MM-DD.

city.description: permit_needed with a city: the city's permit portal and any job rules from the city's own pages.

guide_url.description: Swapwire guide page for this topic.

job.description: permit_needed with a job: the answer for that job; level says whether it is a city or state rule, or none on file.

jobs.description: permit_needed: statewide answers by job, where verified.

numbers.description: Key numbers, e.g. max_deposit_usd, max_deposit_pct, license_required_from_usd.

related.description: Links: the state's rules page, how to check a license, and what to do about a problem contractor.

status.description: verified, or not_verified: could not be confirmed from an official source; send the user to the agency in sources.

topics.description: When no topic is given: one short answer per topic.
